verified_facts.text: Grand Hyatt Bali is a family-friendly beachfront resort in Nusa Dua, Bali.
verified_facts.excerpt: Grand Hyatt Bali is a family-friendly beachfront resort in Nusa Dua, Bali.

verified_facts.text: The resort is steps from the Bali Collection shopping center.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located just minutes from a world-class convention center and steps from the Bali Collection shopping center.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is 15 minutes from Ngurah Rai International Airport.
verified_facts.excerpt: The hotel is just 15 minutes from the Ngurah Rai International Airport.

verified_facts.text: Rooms, suites and villas are set across four villages, all designed in contemporary Balinese style.
verified_facts.excerpt: Grand Hyatt Bali features 636 luxury rooms, suites and villas across four villages, all designed in contemporary Balinese style.

verified_facts.text: Guest rooms have teakwood and marble floors from Central Java, a marble bath with a separate shower and a private balcony.
verified_facts.excerpt: Teakwood and marble from Central Java grace the floors of this 49-square-meter room furnished with a plush king bed, a sofa bed, a marble bath with a separate shower, and a private balcony.

verified_facts.text: Ocean-view rooms have a private balcony overlooking the Indian Ocean's white sandy beaches.
verified_facts.excerpt: a sofa bed, a marble bath with a separate shower, and a private balcony overlooking the Indian Ocean's white sandy beaches.

verified_facts.text: The One-Bedroom Beachfront Villa has Balinese decor, a dining area, a living area, a library and an outdoor patio with ocean views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Opulent Balinese décor welcomes guests in this grand 175-square-meter villa that features a plush king bed, a dining area, a living area, a library and an outdoor patio with ocean views.

verified_facts.text: The villas include a private pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: 3 villas that include a private pool and are featured in clusters of four ethnic villages

verified_facts.text: Family connecting rooms come in mermaid and pirate themes, pairing a parents' room with a themed room for children.
verified_facts.excerpt: Parents/guardians can relax in a larger connected room, while our younger guests can indulge in a whimsical ocean-themed room with plush twin beds in charming shell-shaped frames.

verified_facts.text: A pirate-themed connecting room has a twin bunk bed for children.
verified_facts.excerpt: our younger guests can indulge in the immersive pirate-themed room with a twin bunk bed

verified_facts.text: The resort has five swimming pools.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our luxurious Balinese swim resort features five swimming pools designed to suit your holiday needs.

verified_facts.text: The lagoon-style Main Pool is surrounded by tropical gardens, and the River Pool has two waterslides.
verified_facts.excerpt: Spend the day in the spacious lagoon-style Main Pool surrounded by tropical gardens, or ride down our two waterslides in the River Pool.

verified_facts.text: The secluded Balinese Feature Pool has emerald green water and cascading waterfalls.
verified_facts.excerpt: Find your peace at our secluded Balinese Feature Pool, with emerald green water and cascading waterfalls

verified_facts.text: The Grand Club Pool is reserved for club guests.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Grand Club Pool is exclusively available for our club guests.

verified_facts.text: Kriya Spa draws inspiration from Balinese water palaces and offers bespoke spa and wellness treatments by trained therapists.
verified_facts.excerpt: Drawing inspiration from Balinese water palaces, Kriya Spa offers bespoke spa and wellness treatments delivered by professionally trained therapists.

verified_facts.text: The Bay Club Fitness Center has cardio equipment, machine weights, squash courts and a yoga studio.
verified_facts.excerpt: the Bay Club Fitness Center offers a variety of cardio equipment and machine weights, squash courts and a yoga studio.

verified_facts.text: At the Oceania Kids Club, children learn about Balinese culture and explore the resort's local flora and fauna.
verified_facts.excerpt: allowing your little ones to learn about Balinese culture and explore the resort’s local flora and fauna in a safe and welcoming setting

verified_facts.text: Pasar Senggol is an open-air Balinese night market experience with Indonesian and Balinese food stalls, artisans and live Balinese cultural performances in an amphitheatre.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy your meal in an open-air amphitheatre while being entertained by live Balinese cultural performances.

verified_facts.text: The rooftop Salsa Bar has panoramic views of the Nusa Dua coastline.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy Italian fare at Salsa Verde or a romantic rooftop night at our Salsa Bar with panoramic views of the Nusa Dua coastline.

verified_facts.text: The resort has a golf simulator.
verified_facts.excerpt: Elevate your game with our advanced golf simulator at Grand Hyatt Bali

verified_facts.text: Wedding venues range from tropical gardens to a white, sandy beachfront.
verified_facts.excerpt: From beautifully manicured tropical gardens to a white, sandy beachfront, Grand Hyatt Bali offers numerous venues for weddings and receptions.

verified_facts.text: The hotel no longer provides bottled water or disposable in-room amenities; guests are advised to bring their own essentials and a drinking vessel to refill.
verified_facts.excerpt: our hotel no longer provides bottled water or disposable in-room amenities for staying guests. We recommend bringing your own essentials and a drinking vessel to refill with drinking water available throughout the hotel.
